overview: An emotional transference romance that unfolds as a woman who denies empathy and a man who bears the burden of empathy come to share each other's emotions. Cha Eun Hwan, a man who bears others' emotions excessively. He is a psychological counseling expert who has gained widespread popularity for his unique counseling methods. However, after becoming entangled in an unexpected incident, his everyday life and emotional balance begin to unravel. As he falls into despair, a figure connected to his past appears, bringing changes to both his life and his emotions. Yoo Ji An, a former girl group member who was once called the "Nation's Idol" and enjoyed explosive popularity, is now working as an actress. Having lived her life suppressing her emotions under her mother's strict control since childhood, Ji An faces a crisis due to controversy over her acting skills, stemming from her lack of empathy. She then meets Cha Eun Hwan, a psychological counseling expert, and unexpectedly experiences "emotional transference." Through this experience, she begins to rediscover her lost emotions and grow as a person.

Fighting her way through one crisis after another, she goes from mortal enemies to falling deeply in love with the "jealous" Ling Shenxing. But just as their romance blossoms, she suddenly wakes up in the modern world—only to encounter a familiar face around the corner.

Ta Ruan Zai Wo Xin Shang

UFC superfan, Mario Lopez brings together fan-favorite voices, including C.M. Punk and Ken Shamrock, to break down the rivalries that defined eras, shaped legacies, and helped propel the UFC into a global phenomenon.

Oil, Tum's friend, offers to help him find a roommate to share the rent. Turns out the new roommate is Cheetah aka Chatree, Tum's gay friend who used to be secretly in love with him. Tum cut off his friendship with Cheetah a long time ago because Cheetah tricked him to believe that he was straight.

We are giving them the chance to tell their stories in detail.

overview: Each week on Naked and Afraid: Uncensored, a new pair of total strangers are faced with the ultimate survival challenge: survive for 21 days together with no clothes or supplies in some of the most dangerous environments in the world. In addition to the landscape itself working against the duo, the local wildlife stalks looks to prey on them as well. Of course, the biggest complication for any of the couples might end up being their own clashing egos. This "uncensored" variation includes never-before-seen footage.
title: Naked and Afraid: Uncensored

overview: Cassandre, accustomed to her daily life in a Parisian police station, takes a new position in Annecy, in order to be with her son. This new position in the provinces strongly displeases Cassandra, City inveterate, which hardly supports this new life, too quiet for her taste. She changes her mind quickly when it comes up against equally breathless business than it had to be treated in Paris. Crimes occur, Cassandra and her new team must resolve as quickly as possible so as not to terrorize the population or inflame suspicions.

overview: Ayla, a beautiful young girl, is deeply in love with her cousin Ehtisham. But their love is caught in a long-standing family conflict, where their mothers' hatred keeps them apart at every step. Unseen and unheard, Aoun—a quiet young man living only with his grandmother—carries feelings for Ayla, though she has never noticed him. Sometimes, fate brings two hearts close only to pull them apart again. Their love is tested by family conflicts and hidden betrayals, breaking what once felt strong and real. In the middle of this pain, a broken heart finds comfort in the one who has always loved silently. But this connection is not fully accepted by the heart, as emotions remain confused and uncertain. Will Aoun ever express his love to Ayla? Can Ayla and Ehtisham stay together despite their family conflict? Will Ayla ever realize who truly cares for her?
title: Zabt

overview: Shahzer is a young heir to immense wealth, known for his strong, dominating personality and short temper. Despite his privileged background, his anger and behavior often create distance between him and others. Shifa is a strong, responsible young woman who quietly carries the burden of her family while holding onto her dreams through patience and sacrifice. Maaz, Shifa's cousin and fiancé, shares a close bond with her, and they are already engaged in a relationship built on family trust and mutual understanding. Fate takes an unexpected turn when Shahzer crosses paths with Shifa and feels an unexplainable pull toward her—completely unaware that she is already engaged to Maaz, his closest friend. This hidden truth soon becomes the center of emotional conflict, testing friendship, love, and loyalty. Will Shahzer ever get Shifa, or is she already beyond his reach? Will Maaz discover Shahzer's feelings for Shifa? Will love win for Maaz and Shifa, even with Shahzer around?
title: Tapish

overview: Hercule follows Hercule Poirot's first cases in London before he becomes the world's most famous sleuth. The series is an intimate study of Hercule the man and an epic portrait of Britain between the wars. The series takes a magnifying glass to three of Christie's most celebrated stories, while also charting Hercule's burgeoning friendship with Captain Arthur Hastings, his early encounters with Scotland Yard's James Japp, and introducing him to one particular nemesis...
title: Hercule

overview: Half as Interesting put the 34 weirdest laws in America on a map and gave Sam 72 hours and $5,000 to break eight of them. But the HAI writers got $3,000 and a live tracker on Sam—and if they tag him, he loses a point. None of the rules require anyone to go to sleep at any point. What could possibly go wrong?

overview: Khushbakht is a determined police officer who has already experienced the painful side of love. After a failed love marriage, she returns to her parents' home with her young son and the scars of a broken relationship. Instead of support, she faces constant judgment, slowly losing faith in love. Haroon, an honest journalist who values truth and meaningful connections, struggles to find someone who truly understands him. When an investigation brings them together, he is captivated by Khushbakht's courage, dignity, and quiet strength. For Haroon, it is the beginning of love. For Khushbakht, love is a chapter she believes is over. As their lives become intertwined, Haroon sets out to prove that even the most wounded hearts deserve a second chance at happiness.

overview: A Forgotten Kill is centered on ex–Army Ranger Dani Vega, a Nuyorican from the Lower East Side and dauntless FBI agent whose specialty is breaking codes and detecting patterns. As part of a task force, Dani is partnered with NYPD Detective Mark Flint. Their clashing styles give them an edge in solving crimes and expose an undeniable chemistry, but Dani is haunted by a secret: a family tragedy in her past that comes back to put her career and life at risk.
title: A Forgotten Kill

overview: SWAMP PATROL pulls viewers into the unpredictable world of law enforcement operating in America's most unforgiving swamps. From the tangled bayous of Louisiana to the coastal inlets of Florida, Swamp Patrol follows officers in real time through bodycam footage as they respond to a wide range of threats, including armed suspects, drug busts, missing persons, stolen boats, 11-foot gators, and deadly snakes. Every call comes with its own dangers, and in the depths of the swamp, there is no backup. The series offers a captivating look at the chaos and courage required to hold the line in places most people never step.
title: Swamp Patrol

overview: When a famous actress is murdered, hacker Hades becomes the prime suspect. Captain Phakorn discovers Hades is his old friend, Phirawat. But shocking evidence points to Phakorn himself. As the real killer hunts them down, Phakorn is killed and Phirawat is left severely burned. Lieutenant Viulada helps Phirawat assume Phakorn's identity through surgery. Together, they must unravel the mystery and catch the real villain before it's too late.
title: Ghost

overview: After her husband disappears, Cemre finds herself in the mysterious Coral Mansion, where secrets from the past, family feuds, and forbidden love change her destiny.

overview: Inspired by the remarkable achievements of China's Lunar Exploration Program, this story follows Wu Wei, a young man who has dreamed of working in aerospace since childhood. Determined to join the Flight Control Center, he is devastated when he fails the interview and is instead assigned to work in the archives. Meanwhile, Ying Ziqi, a brilliant and aloof top student with whom Wu Wei shares a long-standing rivalry, successfully secures a position in the Flight Control Center. While working in the archives, Wu Wei gains valuable experience and matures into a dependable professional. Recognizing his potential, mentor Qin Bojun personally selects him to join the Flight Control Department's elite "Mu Xing" team, where he reunites with Ying Ziqi as a teammate. Initially clashing at every turn, the two young talents gradually overcome their differences through a series of high-stakes missions, including the International Space Orbit Competition and the Haoyue-4 and Haoyue-5 lunar projects. As they learn to trust and support one another, Wu Wei and Ying Ziqi transform from rivals into inseparable partners. In a dramatic final challenge, they defy the odds, lead their team to success, and help China accomplish the historic mission of bringing lunar soil samples back to Earth.
title: To the Stars

overview: El mapa de los anhelos tells the moving story of Greta, who claims she was born with the purpose of saving her sister Lucy, who suffers from leukemia, through her stem cells. However, events take an unexpected turn and Lucy passes away, leaving Greta with a deep existential void. Before departing, Lucy creates "El mapa de los anhelos", a game that challenges Greta to face her grief and discover her own path. On this journey, Greta will meet Will, an enigmatic young man with a haunting past. Can we love someone without loving ourselves?
title: El mapa de los anhelos
Xing Xing Ran Shao De Sheng Xia

overview: In Worst Yard on the Block, two teams of curb appeal aficionados will search out the most unsightly yards in the country, meet the overwhelmed homeowners and perform miraculous outdoor makeovers in just a matter of days.

overview: Would You Rather be invisible or be able to fly? Fight one giant duck or 1000 tiny ducks? Eat a man-sized bean or a bean-sized man? This comedy game show will see two teams of some of Britain's funniest digital personalities compete in hilarious real-life challenges based on classic hypothetical Would You Rather decisions. These three simple words decide everything from what they eat to who they send home...

overview: A compelling new two-part documentary charting the dramatic rise and fall of Olympic swimmer Scott Miller, and his ongoing fight to rebuild his life. Once a golden boy of Australian sport, Scott Miller had it all: medals, fame, and a nation's admiration. Then came personal tragedy and a fall into addiction, crime and eventually prison.
title: Deep End: The Scott Miller Story

overview: A striving American is thrown headfirst into the world of superyachts, sun, and scandal over the Hong Kong boating season in this soapy delicious revenge thriller about the wealthy and the secrets they keep. Our story follows Coleen "Cola" Li, a summer associate for a prestigious financial firm, as her mentor introduces her to "The Season": six glorious weeks in the summer where the rich and fabulous host a series of extravagant events. During the opening party aboard a superyacht, Cola meets the important players in Hong Kong. All are beautiful. All are dangerous. All are keeping a secret. But Cola is as well. She's here to get vengeance for a past injustice, no matter the cost. Over six weeks, Cola must navigate the world of the 1%, as she infiltrates high society in their private boxes at the races, charity tables at boxing matches, murder mystery parties at amusement parks, as well as the seedier side of the rich. At the end, Cola faces a choice: do I destroy these people or become them?
title: The Season

overview: From the director of ‘Secret Relationships', follows the romance between an investigator burdened by the stigma of "being a murderer's son" and a prosecutor.

overview: You think you know your neighbors? Think again. This new series features firsthand accounts of violence, intimidation, and harassment that are more shocking than ever. Through compelling testimonials, startling body cam footage, and animated reenactments, Worst Neighbor Ever proves the people next door aren't just a nuisance - they're lethal.

Off camera, Chen Xin and Zhang Zhun begin to lose sight of where acting ends and real feelings begin.

overview: Congregations of thousands thrive in Atlanta's bustling metropolis, but it is not just the preacher men who keep these communities afloat. TLC will premiere The Sisterhood on Tuesday, January 1 at 9 PM ET/PT, a candid look into the larger-than-life preacher wives (aka First Ladies) who work to ensure that their families and churches run as smooth as Southern-churned butter. As wives of preachers, First Ladies are held to undeniably high standards. Expectations can be overwhelming as these powerful and driven women are on a mission to overcome obstacles, break molds, expand social circles and raise families... all under the intense scrutiny and pressure of their respective communities. The Sisterhood provides an honest, behind-the-scenes look into the struggles, triumphs and unique experiences that shape these bold women as they ditch their Sunday hats and morph into the dynamic and influential figures they have become and aim to be.
title: The Sisterhood

overview: Every day, three couples compete to prepare a recipe. Only one partner knows the recipe and must guide their significant other remotely to execute it—a setup that reveals both tensions and the bond between them.
title: Chéri(e), c'est moi le chef

overview: Three couples compete to prepare a recipe. Only one partner knows the recipe and must guide their other half remotely—via an earpiece—to execute it. The guiding partners then taste the dishes blind and rate them on a scale of 1 to 10. The chef also tastes and rates the dishes. The highest-scoring couple wins a prize and secures a spot in the next episode to defend their title...
title: Chéri(e) c'est moi le chef
